task.title: Exchanging an OAuth2 access token for a Red Hat Quay robot account token
task.shortdesc: To authenticate with a federated robot account in Red Hat Quay, you can exchange an OAuth2 access token for a short-lived robot token by using a Python script.

ul.li: You have the python3 CLI tool installed.

note.p: The following example uses a Python script to exchange the OAuth2 access token for a Red Hat Quay robot account token.
